$comment: The one list of MediaMake's guard rails, read by tools/guard-rails.mjs (the pre-edit guard in
On a protected branch, every file git would track is a framework file: Claude may not edit it
or commit there, and the guard says where the change belongs. Your own work is what git ignores
(projects/, out/, brands/, thumbnails/jobs/, overlays/), so it is never blocked.
areas: the first one whose paths match a file gives its hint. A path ending in / is a folder,
* matches inside one folder and ** across folders. allow: committed files that may still change
on a protected branch. leftovers: old folders that may still hold the user's work after a move,
with the command that moves it (untilWorkspace: folders the workspace takes over once one is set,
a nudge until then; ignore: names in them that aren't the user's). When a folder moves, change it here.

leftovers.what: Work from before the rename to apps/studio
leftovers.fix: `mm migrate` lists what would move; `mm migrate --yes` moves it, once the user agrees.

leftovers.what: The user's projects, renders or brand kits are inside the checkout, in {where}.
leftovers.fix: `mm migrate` lists what would move to the workspace (~/MediaMake, outside the checkout, out of git's way); `mm migrate --yes` moves it, once the user agrees.
leftovers.whatOnceSet: The user's projects, renders or brand kits are still in {where}, but the workspace is {workspace}: nothing reads them there.
leftovers.fixOnceSet: `mm migrate` lists what would move into the workspace; `mm migrate --yes` moves it, once the user agrees.

areas.name: generated file
areas.where: It is generated, never edited by hand: SKILLS.md and skills.json come from `node tools/skills.mjs index`, presets.json from `mm sync-presets`. Regenerate it on the branch of the change that needs it.

areas.name: lockfile
areas.where: The lockfile changes only in a PR that changes dependencies. To install on main, use `npm ci`, which leaves it as it is.

areas.name: skill file
areas.where: Skills are shared by everyone who pulls. A lesson from the user goes in the user's notes, never the skill: `mm notes add <skill> "…"` (outside the repo; `mm notes promote <skill>` offers them to the skill's log as a PR). Feedback for this production goes in its own projects/<slug>/prefs.md (git ignores it). A new variant from fork-skill starts as the user's own, outside the repo (`node tools/skills.mjs fork <base> <name>` puts it in the workspace; `publish <name>` sends it as a PR). A fix to the skill itself goes on a branch and a PR.

areas.name: production graphic or catalog entry
areas.where: Anything made for one production belongs in its own folder, projects/<slug>/ in the workspace (`mm workspace`), which git never sees. Only a graphic or entry every production should get goes into the engine, on a branch and a PR.

areas.name: video engine file
areas.where: The user's work (projects/, out/, brands/, thumbnails/jobs/, overlays/) is in the workspace (`mm workspace`), or ignored by git while it is still in apps/studio, and can change on any branch. A change to the engine, its scripts or the sample project goes on a branch and a PR; when one production needs it, say which in the PR.

areas.name: MediaMake app file
areas.where: App changes go on a branch and a PR (feat/… or fix/…).

areas.name: package or MCP server file
areas.where: Packages and MCP servers are released from main, so a change goes on a branch and a PR.

areas.name: repo setup file
areas.where: Repo setup, CI and rules for every session go on a branch and a PR.

default.name: framework file
default.where: Every file git tracks is shared by everyone who pulls, so a change to it goes on a branch and a PR.
